clue.text: Swears at cricket matches

parts.note: Test matches are the long international games of cricket, so tests are cricket matches

explanation.surface: Someone loses their temper and curses while watching international cricket.
explanation.walkthrough: TESTS are Test matches, the five-day international games of cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: To swear in the legal sense is to declare on oath, which is what it means to bear witness formally.

clue.text: Mother upset by American president's surprise attack

indicators.note: by means next to, so the president's name sits beside the mother
in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the letters run upwards

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
George Bush, father and son, were both US presidents

explanation.surface: A mother is upset by a US president launching a sneak attack.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambush is an attack made without warning from a concealed position.

clue.text: Have a meal in attempt to get agreement

indicators.note: in places the meal inside the attempt

parts.note: to try is to attempt
to eat is to have a meal

explanation.surface: Diplomats sit down to dinner hoping to reach a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty is a formal agreement or pact between nations.

clue.text: Unpretentiousness taken for granted in outskirts of Salisbury

indicators.note: in places the assumed thing inside the town's outer letters
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters

parts.note: something implicit is assumed without being stated

explanation.surface: A modest way of life is assumed on the fringes of Salisbury, a cathedral city in England.
explanation.definitionFit: Plainness and lack of affectation are the qualities of someone or something modest, without airs.

clue.text: Small Earl Grey? Maiden put on kettle to make this

definitions.text: put on kettle to make this

parts.note: S is the usual abbreviation for small, on clothes labels
Earl Grey is a kind of tea flavoured with bergamot
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A small cup of Earl Grey, and a young woman is told to put the kettle on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put on kettle' looks like it belongs with 'Maiden', but it is part of the definition: what boiling a kettle makes.
explanation.definitionFit: Water boiled in a kettle gives off vapour, the cloud that rises from the spout.

clue.text: Criminal admires weapon

indicators.note: something criminal is wrong or crooked, so the letters of the next word are set in a crooked order

explanation.surface: A lawbreaker is fond of his gun.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidearm is a small weapon such as a pistol worn at the side or belt.

clue.text: Hawking, perhaps, is nicest organised before ornithologist's back

indicators.note: before puts the shuffled letters ahead of the last letter
organised means put into order, so these letters are arranged afresh
the back of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: Stephen Hawking is said to be friendlier than a birdwatcher behind him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hawking' suggests falconry next to the birdwatcher; it is the physicist Stephen Hawking, and 'perhaps' marks him as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Stephen Hawking was a famous physicist, an example of a researcher in the natural sciences.

clue.text: Dan ignoring an alcoholic drink — beat that!

indicators.note: ignoring something means leaving it out, so those two letters are dropped

parts.note: rum is a spirit distilled from sugar cane

explanation.surface: Dan skips the drink on offer and challenges anyone to do better.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beat that!' reads as a challenge; only 'beat' is the definition, as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To drum is to beat or tap rhythmically, as on a drum skin.

clue.text: Easily persuaded, this writer is captivated by an expert

indicators.note: being captivated means being held captive, so the writer is held inside the next words

parts.note: this writer is the setter speaking of himself, so me
able means skilled or expert

explanation.surface: The writer admits she is easily swayed and charmed by a specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone amenable is open to suggestion, compliant and willing to go along with others.

clue.text: May denies reforms — article's dismissed, displaying imagination

indicators.note: reforms means forms anew, so these letters are reshaped
dismissed means sent away, so the article is left out of the pool

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Theresa May, then the Prime Minister, rejects reforms after a newspaper piece is thrown out, showing creativity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reforms' rearranges the letters of MAY DENIES once 'dismissed' has taken out the A ('article').
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the mental faculty of picturing things, the inner vision of imagination.

clue.text: Ray seen in river? On the contrary, another fish

indicators.note: being seen in something means being contained within it
this reverses the previous instruction, so the river goes in the ray rather than the ray in the river

parts.note: a ray of light is a beam
R is the standard abbreviation for river on maps

explanation.surface: A ray, the flat fish, spotted swimming in a river, and then a second kind of fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ray' looks like the fish, which is why the answer is 'another fish'; here it means a beam of light. 'On the contrary' flips 'seen in', putting R inside BEAM.
explanation.definitionFit: The bream is a freshwater fish of the carp family, a different species from the ray named earlier in the clue.

clue.text: Back exercises before I rehabilitate an individual fond of food and wine

definitions.text: individual fond of food and wine

indicators.note: before means this comes in front of what follows
back here means going backwards, so the abbreviation is read in reverse

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercises
to rehabilitate an addict is to cure them

explanation.surface: A gym-goer does back exercises before going into rehab for indulging too much in food and wine.
explanation.definitionFit: An epicure is a gourmet, devoted to refined eating and drinking, after the philosopher Epicurus who taught pleasure.

clue.text: Local community land chaps hated at heart

parts.note: a bird lands or settles on a branch
chaps are men

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letter, here the middle of the five-letter word

explanation.surface: A village where the men of the place are disliked deep down.
explanation.definitionFit: A settlement is a small place where people live together, such as a village or hamlet.

clue.text: Christmas sometimes involves a church service

indicators.note: the phrase before involves, or contains, the letters of the answer across its two words

explanation.surface: A truthful remark that festive celebrations often include going to church.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer straddles the end of Christmas and the start of sometimes.
explanation.definitionFit: The Eucharist celebrated in Catholic and some Anglican churches is called by this name.

clue.text: Doctor argued once fired up

indicators.note: to doctor something is to tamper with it, so the letters are altered

explanation.surface: A physician once made a heated argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone fired up has been given confidence and spirit, which is to be heartened or spurred on.

clue.text: Party supporter? Now and then

parts.note: a party is a social occasion
an ally is someone who supports you

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a political backer is wanted now, then later.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party supporter' reads as a political loyalist, but the words split into a celebration and a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that happens from time to time, without regularity, is said to happen at intervals of this kind.

clue.text: Water plants inside these?

parts.note: read 'water plants' as greenery grown under water rather than as watering a garden: they live in glass tanks for fish

explanation.surface: A gardening question about where to water the plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Water' looks like a verb, as in watering pot plants; it is an adjective, and the plants are pond weeds grown in fish tanks.
explanation.definitionFit: Glass tanks for keeping fish usually hold underwater weeds as well.

clue.text: Harmful drops from out of the blue?

definitions.text: Harmful drops from out of the blue?

parts.words: Harmful drops from out of the blue?
parts.note: out of the blue usually means unexpectedly, but here it is literally the sky, and the damaging drops are polluted rainfall

explanation.surface: A warning about sudden damaging falls from nowhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of the blue' suggests surprise; read literally it is the blue sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Rainfall made sour by pollution from burning fuel damages forests, lakes and buildings.

clue.text: Fashionable old spy

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in the in thing
former means old, as in a former colleague

explanation.surface: An elegant retired secret agent.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who secretly passes information to the police or authorities acts as a spy or grass.

clue.text: Disturbance after prisoners start to trash building

indicators.note: after places the disturbance behind the prisoners and the first letter

parts.note: cons is short for convicts

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: a ruction is a noisy row or commotion

explanation.surface: Inmates riot and begin smashing up the prison block.
explanation.definitionFit: Construction is the act or trade of putting up structures, as in the building industry, and also a thing built.

clue.text: Photograph pleasant, unfinished meal outside

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a photograph

indicators.note: unfinished means the word's last letter is cut off

parts.note: nice means pleasant

explanation.surface: A snapshot of a lovely half-eaten lunch al fresco.
explanation.definitionFit: A picnic is a meal eaten in the open air, usually from a basket.

clue.text: Make more attractive organ with object on top

indicators.note: in a down clue on top means placed above, so the object comes first

parts.note: an end is an aim or object, as in means to an end
the ear is the organ of hearing

explanation.surface: Fitting an ornament on a church organ to make it more appealing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organ' suggests the church instrument; it is the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: To endear someone is to make them beloved or more appealing to others.

clue.text: Abandon work after dark on a regular basis

indicators.note: after puts the work behind the letters taken from the next word
regular letters are every other one, the first and third here

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Someone advises giving up the job when it gets dark, every day.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop a plan or a friend is to give them up or abandon them.

clue.text: Poor trip abroad, on balance

indicators.note: abroad has the old sense of scattered widely, so the letters are spread about

explanation.surface: A poor holiday overseas, on the whole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on balance' looks like a phrase meaning overall, but 'on' is part of the wordplay and 'balance' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Proportion is the harmonious relation of parts, the same as balance or symmetry in a design.

clue.text: Diarist, we hear, giving looks slyly

indicators.note: we hear means the word is judged by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: Samuel Pepys was the famous 17th-century English diarist

explanation.surface: A diarist is said to be casting sly glances.
explanation.walkthrough: Samuel Pepys kept a famous diary of 1660s London; his surname is said like 'peeps'.
explanation.definitionFit: To take quick furtive glances through a gap is to peek or look slyly.

clue.text: Expression of triumphant surprise going round one American state

indicators.note: going round means encircling, so the exclamation surrounds the numeral

parts.note: oho is an exclamation of triumph or surprise
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A gleeful cry as someone tours a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Ohio is one of the states of the USA, in the Midwest.

clue.text: A revolting slum? He's encapsulated old, poor residence

indicators.note: the shuffled letters enclose the abbreviation like a capsule
revolting can mean turning over or rebelling, so the letters are overturned

explanation.surface: Someone says a slum is disgusting, and he has a very old poor person inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolting' makes LMSHUSE, which 'encapsulated' wraps round O; the surface's disgusting slum hides that 'revolting' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An almshouse was a charitable home built for the poor, often elderly people, to live in for free.

clue.text: Information about style

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
re means about or concerning, as in letters

explanation.surface: A request for some facts about fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: GEN is British informal slang for information, as in 'get the gen'.
explanation.definitionFit: A genre is a type or style of art, music or writing, such as jazz or crime fiction.

clue.text: Common sense keeps the Queen very worried

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it inside, so one word contains the others

parts.note: nous is British slang for practical good sense
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen

explanation.surface: Royal courtiers have the sense to keep the Queen from being alarmed.
explanation.definitionFit: Being anxious or apprehensive is the same as being worried.

clue.text: Motorcycle passenger gets in this drink

definitions.meaning: a small car attached to the side of a motorbike for a passenger
a cocktail of brandy, orange liqueur and lemon juice

explanation.surface: A pillion rider climbs into something and then has a cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the one-wheeled passenger car bolted to a motorbike and a classic brandy cocktail.
